0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-4, 0-3 at home) host the Washington Wizards (3-3) in Orlando's seventh game of the season, with the Magic currently 9th in the East and one game back of the 5th-place Southeast standing, after a loss in their last game. The Wizards, who lead the Southeast and sit 6th in the East, have won their last game, and the teams have not met yet this season, though Orlando won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-131 win in Orlando on March 12. For the Magic, Anthony Black (rest), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) are out, while the Wizards are without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
